text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm currently staffing a fan event where Eishin Flash and Smart Falcon are performing. Or, supposed to be performing, that is...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What? You can't get the music to start?
But we've
still got a song left...

text_block_list.name: Sound Engineer
text_block_list.text:
We're scrambling to swap in new
equipment, but
it'll be a few minutes
before everything's hooked
up...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sure! We can go do a little talk segment.
A good
Umadol's gotta face everything
with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to ad-lib along. Lead the
way,
Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And so I'd practice dancing in front of
the TV as a
kid, pretending I was one of
the idols! Hehe,
should I do a little
example dance?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: YEAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thanks, everyone! ☆ Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Sparkle! Sparkle! ♪
Could this be a
spark of love? ♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Awwww!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(My... Impressive, as always. The
audience is
going wild!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Flash, what about you? Did you
ever
pretend to be an idol as a kid?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Oh! All right, now I've just got to follow
her
example, and...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not quite, but I was a knight in our
elementary
school play. I still remember
the part.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My beautiful princess—on my honor as
your
knight, I give you my eternal,
unwavering loyalty!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ah?! AAAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Wow! The cheers are reverberating so
loud, I can
physically feel the sound...
This must be what has
Falcon so
enamored with the stage.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Backstage, we get the setup fixed, and
the show
moves to the last song without
further issue. If
anything, the crowd is
extra energized from the
talk segment!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Can I get a cheer from everyone?
"Lovey
lovey, lovely Falcooo!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: LOVEY LOVEY, LOVELY FALCOOO!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Could I ask for a cheer as well?

"Lieblich, lieblich, liebliche Flash!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
LIEBLICH, LIEBLICH! LIEBLICHE
FLAAASH!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Again! We'd love to hear your voices
more. Let's
all make this show one to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can hardly believe it! That was even
livelier than
usual!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Flash! She totally had
my back
with that ad-libbed talk sesh,
and she hyped up
the crowd like crazy
after the last song!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all thanks to your shining
example, Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
All I did was follow your lead, and next
thing I
knew, the crowd was raving.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Feeling that energy myself, I think I've
come to
understand your passion for
your Umadol
activities.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash! Flaaaash! Oh my gosh, c'mere,
gimme a
hug! ☆

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Encore! Encooore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd's still warmed up and eager
for more...
There's got to be a little
something extra we can
do for the fans.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
More talk... yes, we'll see what we can
do, then.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And then, Flash was like, "For optimal

consistency, it needs another seven
turns." I've
never seen someone so
locked in stirring natto,
but she was in
bliss!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
W-wait, Falcon?! They don't need to
hear about
that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The audience goes home with big smiles
after
Smart Falcon's silly story about
Eishin Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My talents... Yes, I believe I could
demonstrate
something of interest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the encore. Allow me to
perform a
soccer juggling trick for you.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she's amazing!
She's so skilled!

Bravooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The audience is floored by the
unexpected
demonstration of Eishin
Flash's juggling prowess!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the encore. Allow me to
perform a
soccer juggling trick for you.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Ooh, uh... That's kinda cool, I guess!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's probably not what the audience had
in mind
for the encore, but the juggling
display is
impressive nonetheless.
